run_eval_linear: run the eval_linear script to train a linear classifier on top of frozen convolutional layers of an AlexNet model
create_RegLog: create a RegLog module that builds logistic regression on top of a specified frozen convolutional layer
run_forward: run the forward function to extract features from a specific convolutional layer of the model
test_accuracy: test the accuracy function to compute precision at k for classification output and target tensors
run_validate: run the validate function to evaluate the model on a validation dataset and return top1, top5 accuracy and loss
